answer: Give every agent a heartbeat check: before trading, an agent must keep a steady pulse of signed, useful work over time, like a walnut that only cracks open after repeated honest effort. A newcomer starts in a shallow canyon of low trust, allowed small jobs but unable to move large value until its record deepens. Spinning up a hundred fakes means keeping a hundred separate pulses alive, each costing compute and time, while one honest agent pays once. Fakes starve; real reputations grow.
